_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 27: late October 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they push in during the late midnight hour on 31 October they could get this flipped, and repeats that he saw major uprising, rioting and pillaging.
mentions.quote: in the late midnight hour on October 31st, we could get this flipped
mentions.condition_text: the outcome is explicitly conditional on praying that night
mentions.falsify_match: The New York mayoral race flipping against expectation, and rioting following.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not flip, which the prayer condition absorbs.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord will share with him and he can send his son to tell the live stream what is about to take place, comparing it to Moses being sent up the mountain because the people would not come themselves.
mentions.quote: I'll share with you, son, and you can go tell them on that
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for struggling single mothers worried about providing tomorrow, saying his God shall supply and not the government.
mentions.quote: But my God shall supply. Not my government, but my God shall supply
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private provision. Given during the federal shutdown when food assistance was in question.

mentions.claim_text: He notes it is almost 31 October and almost 1 November, then Thanksgiving and Christmas and the whole fun holiday season.
mentions.quote: we're almost to November 1st. Then we're Thanksgiving in America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that they remain one nation under God upholding the Constitution, and calls out the RINOs and others in office he says are set out to destroy the country.
mentions.quote: that are in office that are that are set out just to destroy our country
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession, and no one is named.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that everything they do will be supernatural, whether with crypto, gold, silver or housing, because God provides.
mentions.quote: everything that you do with crypto, with gold, with silver, or the housing
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private investment outcomes over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees it on their minds, that it is pressure from the outside on them to make this decision, and hears you do what we tell you to do.
mentions.quote: It's pressure from the outside. It's pressure on them to make this decision
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of external coercion on the officials deciding the shutdown.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such evidence, and nobody is named.

mentions.claim_text: He describes what look like labs with people in white outfits and white counters, and says it is touching special interests and pet projects, asking why they are resisting so hard.
mentions.quote: They have white outfits on and I see white counters
mentions.falsify_match: Laboratory funding revealed as the sticking point in the budget fight.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a vision beginning on New Year's Eve where he could hear the music and feel the anticipation people have for the year, and names 2026 with people excited.
mentions.quote: at the beginning you have anticipation for the year. I could feel it. 2026
mentions.falsify_match: A year that begins with optimism, which is the setup for the pig and thin gold material.

mentions.claim_text: Light banter about comfy clothes and being in the woods together before the session starts.
mentions.quote: We're in the woods together now
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: chatter.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a man who is not born again saying they are going to go get food because they already know what is coming, and ties it back to a video from about 3 April 2024.
mentions.quote: We're going to go get food cuz we already know what's coming
mentions.falsify_match: Food stockpiling becoming widespread enough that unbelievers do it too.

mentions.claim_text: He replays that half the flag started turning digital and went all electronic, with people lined up for food again, and repeats the question of why it has not happened yet.
mentions.quote: HALF THAT FLAG STARTED TURNING DIGITAL AND IT STARTED GOING AND IT WENT ALL ELECTRONIC
mentions.falsify_match: America going fully digital in payments alongside food queues.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for finishing the work of cleaning up the church across all denominations all the way into the first of 2026, and says the great revival is about to take place because he is getting them ready.
mentions.quote: into 2026 the first of 2026. The Father you're cleaning up the church
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of church scandals resolving by early 2026, followed by revival.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that it is on their minds, that it is pressure from the outside on them to make this decision, and that he hears you do what we tell you to do.
mentions.quote: It's pressure from the outside. It's pressure on them to make this decision
mentions.falsify_match: Word for word repeat of 24Jlhvohs0c@159 from the previous day.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he is seeing is very troublesome and heavy in the natural, reports the Lord saying he shows him pieces at a time to keep him going, and says right now they take authority over the budget.
mentions.quote: I show you pieces at a time. I keep you going
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it explains the fragmentary form: he is given pieces, never a whole.

mentions.claim_text: He teaches that anointing with oil and the prayer of faith will heal the sick, says he believes in the power of the covenant, and that people will have to learn this in these last days or they will not make it.
mentions.quote: learn that in these last days or you're not going to make it
mentions.condition_text: survival conditioned on learning to operate the covenant
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a condition that assigns any failure to the hearer.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces a replay by saying the Lord told him to pray over this today because this is where they are right now, and dates the original to 7 April 2024.
mentions.quote: This is where we are right now. April the 7th of 2024
mentions.falsify_match: The original is in this corpus at dq4Jz74Kpfw, dated 7 April 2024, so the citation is accurate.

mentions.claim_text: The replayed clip: people with signs demanding their entitlements, welfare and food stamps because all government funded welfare programmes were cut off.
mentions.quote: All of the governmentf funded welfare programs were gone
mentions.falsify_match: Replayed during the November 2025 SNAP funding lapse, which is the closest the claim has come to landing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Programmes are restored rather than ended.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is coming to an end and Jesus Christ is coming again, that it is time to get excited and have expectation, and that he feels the anointing all over him without knowing what to do with it.
mentions.quote: coming to an end. That Jesus Christ is coming again
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an imminence claim with no date.

mentions.claim_text: He warns not to trust so easily because people may come across as Christian and good, and to walk with discernment and heed the inward check.
mentions.quote: Don't trust so easily. They may come across as Christian
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it belongs with hundreds-of-false-prophets: he tells his audience to check people who present as Christian.

mentions.claim_text: He says they keep praying until the Lord says to, that they are winners going through 31 October, and that they have had about five thousand five hundred people praying with them.
mentions.quote: We've had uh 5,500 people praying right
mentions.falsify_match: A concurrent viewer figure, checkable against the stream, and well short of the million prayer army goal.

mentions.claim_text: He compares people who hear him without taking it in to a cow chewing its cud, addressing the farmers who will know what he means.
mentions.quote: You ever seen a cow chew its cud?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an aside.

mentions.claim_text: He asks his son to pull up a prior word about LeBron James and the king being dethroned, and it turns out not to have been saved.
mentions.quote: LeBron James and the king will be dethroned?
mentions.falsify_match: A prior statement about LeBron James being dethroned, cited against the betting scandal.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip was not saved and cannot be produced, which he says on air.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is on India and that there will be a humbling, repeating the word humbling many times, and that they are all oppressed.
mentions.quote: on India. And they'll be a humbling within a humbling
mentions.falsify_match: A national humbling of India, economic or political.

mentions.claim_text: He reports a betting ring uncovered in America involving basketball with LeBron allegedly involved, notes he has to say allegedly, and says it is very serious and asks what happens if it escalates.
mentions.quote: ring has been uncovered in America involving the basketball
mentions.falsify_match: The NBA betting investigation is public record; whether it reaches the named player is not.

mentions.claim_text: He notes India buying oil and joining up with Russia while Russia is upset about sanctions, and says at least twenty five states will cut off funding for all of it if the budget is not passed by Saturday of next week.
mentions.quote: 25 states are if they don't pass the budget by by Saturday of next week
mentions.falsify_match: State level funding cutoffs in early November 2025 absent a budget deal.
